trap-negation-contrast.evidence: Full read of alg:frobenius-pairing. No constructions from the ten categories; zero spaced em-dashes. VERIFIED: <a,b>_F = tr_M(ab) is symmetric exactly by the cyclicity axiom the step-3 block states, so the block's 'making it symmetric' is sound.
trap-negation-contrast.notes: NOT A TRAP, reported separately, two items. (1) The Python API entry point does not expose the algorithm the block specifies. The block's Output is the scalar <a,b>_F plus a boolean S^2 = id; the cited pyhecke.check_frobenius does neither - I read it (tools/pyhecke/python/pyhecke/atom.py:170), and it checks Frobenius POSITIVITY G.x >= 0 and returns (stable, Gx, violations). This appendix is a maintenance contract between proposition and Python API, so the mismatch is exactly what it exists to catch. (2) Same codomain point as step 3: <a,b>_F is given as R[q, q^-1] but the Markov parameter is rational in q.
